description: Personalized CVs and Cover Letters tailored to your tone, persona, and job ad using AI.
tailored-cvs-and-cover-letters: Tailored CVs & Cover Letters. Every Job. Every Time. Let AI instantly refine your resume and cover letter to match your tone, persona, and every job you apply for—no templates, no guesswork. Get fully personalized, professional documents that help you stand out in every application.

why-this-matters.title: Why This Matters
why-this-matters.description: Tired of generic applications getting ignored? Struggling to match your voice to each job post?

generic-isnt-getting-you-interviews.title: Generic Isn’t Getting You Interviews
generic-isnt-getting-you-interviews.description: Let’s face it — hiring managers can spot a cookie-cutter CV from a mile away. If your application doesn’t speak directly to the job, it’s probably not getting noticed.

your-voice-lost-in-translation.title: Your Voice, Lost in Translation
your-voice-lost-in-translation.description: You’re professional, driven, maybe even a little quirky — but does your application show that? If your tone doesn’t match the job or reflect your unique personality, you’re missing out on real opportunities.

we-fix-that-automatically.title: We Fix That — Automatically
we-fix-that-automatically.description: Our AI transforms your base CV and cover letter into job-winning applications tailored to each job ad. It adapts your voice — whether professional, confident, humble, or creative — and matches it perfectly to what the role and company are looking for. No templates. No guesswork. Just high-impact applications that actually sound like you — and get results.

why-this-matters.ready-to-stand-out: Ready to stand out? Let’s make every application count.

how-it-works.title: How It Works
how-it-works.description: Get a tailored CV and cover letter in three simple steps.

step-1.title: Paste your CV and job ad
step-1.description: Paste your CV in any language – we’ll tailor it to a new language based on job description to match your target role.

step-2.title: Choose your persona and tone
step-2.description: Define your professional persona (e.g., ‘Empathetic Designer’, ‘Data-Driven Engineer’) and preferred tone (e.g., Bold, Formal, Witty) to personalize your application.

step-3.title: Receive a customized CV + cover letter instantly
step-3.description: Each application is uniquely crafted — reflecting your voice and tailored precisely to the role you’re pursuing.

what-makes-us-different.title: What Makes Us Different
what-makes-us-different.description: Our AI creates applications that stand out and get noticed.

tailored-for-each-job-ad.title: Tailored for Each Job Ad
tailored-for-each-job-ad.description: Personalized based on the job description.

choose-tone-and-persona.title: Choose Tone & Persona
